en:
Tired of copying and pasting the same text over and over?
MyQuickPaste is a lightweight and powerful tool that lets you save your frequently used text and paste it instantly with just one click.
Perfect for:

AI prompts (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)
Programming code snippets
Email templates
Repetitive messages
Any text you use regularly

Features:

Up to 100 saved snippets
Organize with 5 tabs (A–E)
Copy history (last 20 items)
Clean and simple interface
Works with any application

Stop wasting time on repetitive typing.
Save once, paste anywhere.
ja:
